Studies from the University of Tokyo have shown that cats recognize their owners' voices—they simply choose not to respond. Not out of disdain, but because of evolution.

Unlike dogs, which were domesticated for cooperation, cats are solitary predators. They don't need approval. They don't need validation. They need control.
